verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ יֵה֣וּא בֶן־ חֲנָ֔נִי עַל־ בַּעְשָׁ֖א לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yê·hū ḇen- ḥă·nā·nî ‘al- ba‘·šā lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Jehu son of Hanani against Baasha saying
verses.literalPt: A palavra de Jeová veio a Jeú, filho de Hanani, contra Baasa, dizendo:

verses.original: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֲרִימֹתִ֙יךָ֙ מִן־ הֶ֣עָפָ֔ר וָאֶתֶּנְךָ֣ נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַתֵּ֣לֶךְ׀ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יָרָבְעָ֗ם וַֽתַּחֲטִא֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְהַכְעִיסֵ֖נִי בְּחַטֹּאתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an ’ă·šer hă·rî·mō·ṯî·ḵā min- he·‘ā·p̄ār wā·’et·ten·ḵā nā·ḡîḏ ‘al ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl wat·tê·leḵ bə·ḏe·reḵ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām wat·ta·ḥă·ṭi ’eṯ- ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl lə·haḵ·‘î·sê·nî bə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯām
verses.literal: Even though I lifted you out of the dust and made you ruler over My people Israel you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have caused My people Israel to sin and to provoke Me to anger by their sins
verses.literalPt: Porquanto te exaltei do pó e te constituí príncipe sobre o meu povo de Israel, e tens andado no caminho de Jeroboão e tens feito o meu povo de Israel pecar, para me provocar à ira com os seus pecados,

verses.original: הִנְנִ֥י מַבְעִ֛יר אַחֲרֵ֥י בַעְשָׁ֖א וְאַחֲרֵ֣י בֵית֑וֹ וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣יתְךָ֔ כְּבֵ֖ית יָרָבְעָ֥ם בֶּן־ נְבָֽט׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî maḇ·‘îr ’a·ḥă·rê ḇa‘·šā wə·’a·ḥă·rê ḇê·ṯōw wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- bê·ṯə·ḵā kə·ḇêṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ
verses.literal: So now I will consume Baasha and his house and I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat
verses.literalPt: eis que hei de exterminar a Baasa e a sua casa e hei de fazer a tua casa como a casa de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate.

verses.original: הַמֵּ֤ת לְבַעְשָׁא֙ בָּעִ֔יר יֹֽאכְל֖וּ הַכְּלָבִ֑ים וְהַמֵּ֥ת לוֹ֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה יֹאכְל֖וּ ע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ham·mêṯ lə·ḇa‘·šā bā·‘îr yō·ḵə·lū hak·kə·lā·ḇîm wə·ham·mêṯ lōw baś·śā·ḏeh yō·ḵə·lū ‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: Anyone belonging to Baasha who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs and anyone who dies in the field will be eaten by the birds of the air
verses.literalPt: Quem morrer a Baasa na cidade, comê-lo-ão os cães; e quem lhe morrer no campo, comê-lo-ão as aves do céu.

verses.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י בַעְשָׁ֛א וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה וּגְבֽוּרָת֑וֹ הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê ḇa‘·šā wa·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ū·ḡə·ḇū·rā·ṯōw hă·lō- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Baasha along with his accomplishments . . . and might are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ora, o restante dos atos de Baasa, e o que ele fez, e a sua força não estão, porventura, escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel?

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב בַּעְשָׁא֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּתִרְצָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֵלָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ ba‘·šā ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·qā·ḇêr bə·ṯir·ṣāh way·yim·lōḵ ’ê·lāh ḇə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Baasha rested with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah and his son Elah reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Baasa adormeceu com seus pais e foi sepultado em Tirza. Em seu lugar, reinou seu filho Elá.

verses.original: וְגַ֡ם בְּיַד־ יֵה֨וּא בֶן־ חֲנָ֜נִי הַנָּבִ֗יא דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֡ה הָיָה֩ אֶל־ בַּעְשָׁ֨א וְאֶל־ בֵּית֜וֹ וְעַ֥ל כָּל־ הָרָעָ֣ה׀ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֣ה׀ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה לְהַכְעִיסוֹ֙ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדָ֔יו לִהְי֖וֹת כְּבֵ֣ית יָרָבְעָ֑ם וְעַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ הִכָּ֖ה אֹתֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam bə·yaḏ- yê·hū ḇen- ḥă·nā·nî han·nā·ḇî də·ḇar- Yah·weh hā·yāh ’el- ba‘·šā wə·’el- bê·ṯōw wə·‘al kāl- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh lə·haḵ·‘î·sōw bə·ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏāw lih·yō·wṯ kə·ḇêṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām wə·‘al ’ă·šer- hik·kāh ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Moreover the word of the LORD came through the prophet Jehu son of Hanani against Baasha and his house because of all the evil he had done in the sight of the LORD provoking Him to anger with the work of his hands and becoming like the house of Jeroboam and also because Baasha had struck down the house of Jeroboam
verses.literalPt: Além disso, veio por intermédio do profeta Jeú, filho de Hanani, a palavra de Jeová contra Baasa e contra a sua casa, não somente por causa de todo o mal que ele fez à vista de Jeová, para o provocar à ira com a obra das suas mãos, fazendo-se como a casa de Jeroboão, mas também porque matou a Jeroboão.

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָשֵׁשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְאָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ אֵלָ֨ה בֶן־ בַּעְשָׁ֧א עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּתִרְצָ֖ה שְׁנָתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ ‘eś·rîm wā·šêš šā·nāh lə·’ā·sā me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh mā·laḵ ’ê·lāh ḇen- ba‘·šā ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl bə·ṯir·ṣāh šə·nā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: In the twenty-sixth . . . year of Asa’s reign over Judah Elah son of Baasha became king of Israel and he reigned in Tirzah two years
verses.literalPt: No vigésimo sexto ano de Asa, rei de Judá, começou Elá, filho de Baasa, a reinar sobre Israel, em Tirza, e reinou dois anos.

verses.original: וַיִּקְשֹׁ֤ר עָלָיו֙ עַבְדּ֣וֹ זִמְרִ֔י שַׂ֖ר מַחֲצִ֣ית הָרָ֑כֶב וְה֤וּא בְתִרְצָה֙ שֹׁתֶ֣ה שִׁכּ֔וֹר בֵּ֣ית אַרְצָ֔א אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ הַבַּ֖יִת בְּתִרְצָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·šōr ‘ā·lāw ‘aḇ·dōw zim·rî śar ma·ḥă·ṣîṯ hā·rā·ḵeḇ wə·hū ḇə·ṯir·ṣāh šō·ṯeh šik·kō·wr bêṯ ’ar·ṣā ’ă·šer ‘al- hab·ba·yiṯ bə·ṯir·ṣāh
verses.literal: However, while Elah was in Tirzah getting drunk . . . in the house of Arza the steward of his household there Elah’s servant Zimri the commander of half his chariots conspired against him
verses.literalPt: Conspirou contra ele o seu servo Zinri, comandante da metade dos seus carros. Achava-se Elá em Tirza, embebedando-se na casa de Arsa, que era seu mordomo em Tirza.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א זִמְרִי֙ וַיַּכֵּ֣הוּ וַיְמִיתֵ֔הוּ בִּשְׁנַת֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וָשֶׁ֔בַע לְאָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō zim·rî way·yak·kê·hū way·mî·ṯê·hū biš·naṯ ‘eś·rîm wā·še·ḇa‘ lə·’ā·sā me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: So in the twenty-seventh . . . year of Asa’s reign over Judah Zimri went in struck Elah down and killed him And Zimri reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Entrou Zinri, e o feriu, e o matou no ano vigésimo sétimo de Asa, rei de Judá, e reinou em lugar dele.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י בְמָלְכ֜וֹ כְּשִׁבְתּ֣וֹ עַל־ כִּסְא֗וֹ הִכָּה֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ בֵּ֣ית בַּעְשָׁ֔א לֹֽא־ הִשְׁאִ֥יר ל֖וֹ מַשְׁתִּ֣ין בְּקִ֑יר וְגֹאֲלָ֖יו וְרֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇə·mā·lə·ḵōw kə·šiḇ·tōw ‘al- kis·’ōw hik·kāh ’eṯ- kāl- bêṯ ba‘·šā lō- hiš·’îr lōw maš·tîn bə·qîr wə·ḡō·’ă·lāw wə·rê·‘ê·hū
verses.literal: As soon as Zimri began to reign and was seated on the throne he struck down the entire household of Baasha He did not leave a single male . . . whether a kinsman or friend
verses.literalPt: Quando ele começou a reinar, logo que se assentou no seu trono, feriu a toda a casa de Baasa, sem deixar a este um só homem, nem dos seus parentes nem dos seus amigos.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁמֵ֣ד זִמְרִ֔י אֵ֖ת כָּל־ בֵּ֣ית בַּעְשָׁ֑א כִּדְבַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר אֶל־ בַּעְשָׁ֔א בְּיַ֖ד יֵה֥וּא הַנָּבִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·mêḏ zim·rî ’êṯ kāl- bêṯ ba‘·šā kiḏ·ḇar Yah·weh ’ă·šer dib·ber ’el- ba‘·šā bə·yaḏ yê·hū han·nā·ḇî
verses.literal: So Zimri destroyed the entire household of Baasha according to the word that the LORD had spoken against Baasha through Jehu the prophet
verses.literalPt: Assim, extinguiu Zinri toda a casa de Baasa, conforme a palavra que Jeová falou contra Baasa, por intermédio do profeta Jeú,

verses.original: אֶ֚ל כָּל־ חַטֹּ֣אות בַּעְשָׁ֔א וְחַטֹּ֖אות אֵלָ֣ה בְנ֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטְא֗וּ וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶחֱטִ֙יאוּ֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְהַכְעִ֗יס אֶת־ יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּהַבְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’el kāl- ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ ba‘·šā wə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ ’ê·lāh ḇə·nōw ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭə·’ū wa·’ă·šer he·ḥĕ·ṭî·’ū ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl lə·haḵ·‘îs ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl bə·haḇ·lê·hem
verses.literal: This happened because of all the sins Baasha and his son Elah had committed and had caused Israel to commit provoking the LORD the God of Israel, to anger with their worthless idols
verses.literalPt: por causa de todos os pecados de Baasa, e dos pecados de seu filho Elá, que eles cometeram, e pelos que fizeram Israel pecar, irritando com as suas vaidades a Jeová, Deus de Israel.

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י אֵלָ֖ה וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֽוֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê ’ê·lāh wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hă·lō·w- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Elah along with all his accomplishments . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ora, o restante dos atos de Elá e tudo o que ele fez não estão, porventura, escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel?

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַת֩ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וָשֶׁ֜בַע שָׁנָ֗ה לְאָסָא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה מָלַ֥ךְ זִמְרִ֛י שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים בְּתִרְצָ֑ה וְהָעָ֣ם חֹנִ֔ים עַֽל־ גִּבְּת֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַפְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ ‘eś·rîm wā·še·ḇa‘ šā·nāh lə·’ā·sā me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh mā·laḵ zim·rî šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm bə·ṯir·ṣāh wə·hā·‘ām ḥō·nîm ‘al- gib·bə·ṯō·wn ’ă·šer lap·pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: In the twenty-seventh . . . . . . year of Asa’s reign over Judah Zimri reigned in Tirzah for seven days Now the troops were encamped against Gibbethon of the Philistines
verses.literalPt: No vigésimo sétimo ano de Asa, rei de Judá, reinou Zinri sete dias em Tirza. O povo estava acampado contra Gibetom, que pertencia aos filisteus.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע הָעָם֙ הַחֹנִ֣ים לֵאמֹ֔ר קָשַׁ֣ר זִמְרִ֔י וְגַ֖ם הִכָּ֣ה אֶת־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיַּמְלִ֣כוּ כָֽל־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל אֶת־ עָמְרִ֨י שַׂר־ צָבָ֧א עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ hā·‘ām ha·ḥō·nîm lê·mōr qā·šar zim·rî wə·ḡam hik·kāh ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ way·yam·li·ḵū ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- ‘ā·mə·rî śar- ṣā·ḇā ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl bay·yō·wm ha·hū bam·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: and the people in the camp . . . heard that Zimri had conspired against the king and struck him down So there in the camp that very day all Israel proclaimed Omri the commander of the army king over Israel
verses.literalPt: O povo que estava acampado ouviu dizer: Zinri acaba de conspirar contra o rei e de matá-lo. Pelo que, naquele dia, no arraial, todo o Israel constituiu rei sobre Israel a Onri, general do exército.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲלֶ֥ה עָמְרִ֛י וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עִמּ֖וֹ מִֽגִּבְּת֑וֹן וַיָּצֻ֖רוּ עַל־ תִּרְצָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·leh ‘ā·mə·rî wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl ‘im·mōw mig·gib·bə·ṯō·wn way·yā·ṣu·rū ‘al- tir·ṣāh
verses.literal: Then Omri and all the Israelites marched up from Gibbethon and besieged . . . Tirzah
verses.literalPt: Subiu, de Gibetom, Onri com todo o Israel, e sitiaram a Tirza.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י כִּרְא֤וֹת זִמְרִי֙ כִּֽי־ נִלְכְּדָ֣ה הָעִ֔יר וַיָּבֹ֖א אֶל־ אַרְמ֣וֹן בֵּית־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיִּשְׂרֹ֨ף עָלָ֧יו אֶת־ בֵּֽית־ מֶ֛לֶךְ בָּאֵ֖שׁ וַיָּמֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kir·’ō·wṯ zim·rî kî- nil·kə·ḏāh hā·‘îr way·yā·ḇō ’el- ’ar·mō·wn bêṯ- ham·me·leḵ way·yiś·rōp̄ ‘ā·lāw ’eṯ- bêṯ- me·leḵ bā·’êš way·yā·mōṯ
verses.literal: When Zimri saw that the city was captured he entered . . . the citadel of the royal palace and burned it down . . . upon himself So he died
verses.literalPt: Vendo Zinri que a cidade era tomada, entrou no castelo da casa do rei, e queimou-a sobre si, e morreu,

verses.original: עַל־ חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֔א לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יָרָבְעָ֔ם וּבְחַטָּאתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה לְהַחֲטִ֖יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- ḥaṭ·ṭå̄·ṯō ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh lā·le·ḵeṯ bə·ḏe·reḵ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ū·ḇə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lə·ha·ḥă·ṭî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: because of the sins he had committed doing evil in the sight of the LORD and following the example of Jeroboam and the sin he had committed and had caused Israel to commit
verses.literalPt: por causa dos pecados que cometeu, fazendo o mal à vista de Jeová, andando no caminho de Jeroboão e no pecado que este cometeu, para fazer Israel pecar.

verses.original: וְיֶ֙תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י זִמְרִ֔י וְקִשְׁר֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָשָׁ֑ר הֲלֹֽא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê zim·rî wə·qiš·rōw ’ă·šer qā·šār hă·lō- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Zimri and the treason he committed are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ora, o restante dos atos de Zinri e a traição que praticou não estão, porventura, escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel?

verses.original: אָ֧ז יֵחָלֵ֛ק הָעָ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַחֵ֑צִי חֲצִ֨י הָעָ֜ם הָ֠יָה אַחֲרֵ֨י תִבְנִ֤י בֶן־ גִּינַת֙ לְהַמְלִיכ֔וֹ וְהַחֲצִ֖י אַחֲרֵ֥י עָמְרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz yê·ḥā·lêq hā·‘ām yiś·rā·’êl la·ḥê·ṣî ḥă·ṣî hā·‘ām hā·yāh ’a·ḥă·rê ṯiḇ·nî ḇen- gî·naṯ lə·ham·lî·ḵōw wə·ha·ḥă·ṣî ’a·ḥă·rê ‘ā·mə·rî
verses.literal: At that time the people of Israel were divided Half . . . of the people supported . . . Tibni son of Ginath as king and half supported Omri
verses.literalPt: Então, se dividiu o povo de Israel em dois partidos: metade do povo seguia a Tibni, filho de Ginate, para o constituir rei; e outra metade seguia a Onri.

verses.original: וַיֶּחֱזַ֤ק הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַחֲרֵ֣י עָמְרִ֔י אֶת־ הָעָ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַחֲרֵ֖י תִּבְנִ֣י בֶן־ גִּינַ֑ת וַיָּ֣מָת תִּבְנִ֔י וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ עָמְרִֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ye·ḥĕ·zaq hā·‘ām ’ă·šer ’a·ḥă·rê ‘ā·mə·rî ’eṯ- hā·‘ām ’ă·šer ’a·ḥă·rê tiḇ·nî ḇen- gî·naṯ way·yā·māṯ tiḇ·nî way·yim·lōḵ ‘ā·mə·rî
verses.literal: But the followers - of Omri proved stronger than those - of Tibni son of Ginath So Tibni died and Omri became king
verses.literalPt: O povo, porém, que seguia a Onri prevaleceu contra o que seguia a Tibni, filho de Ginate. Assim, morreu Tibni, e reinou Onri.

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַת֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וְאַחַ֜ת שָׁנָ֗ה לְאָסָא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה מָלַ֤ךְ עָמְרִי֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה בְּתִרְצָ֖ה מָלַ֥ךְ שֵׁשׁ־ שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ šə·lō·šîm wə·’a·ḥaṯ šā·nāh lə·’ā·sā me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh mā·laḵ ‘ā·mə·rî ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl šə·têm ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh bə·ṯir·ṣāh mā·laḵ šêš- šā·nîm
verses.literal: In the thirty-first . . . year of Asa’s reign over Judah Omri became king of Israel and he reigned twelve . . . years six of them in Tirzah
verses.literalPt: No trigésimo primeiro ano de Asa, rei de Judá, começou Onri a reinar sobre Israel e reinou doze anos. Em Tirza, reinou seis anos.

verses.original: וַיִּ֜קֶן אֶת־ הָהָ֥ר שֹׁמְר֛וֹן מֵ֥אֶת שֶׁ֖מֶר בְּכִכְּרַ֣יִם כָּ֑סֶף וַיִּ֙בֶן֙ אֶת־ הָהָ֔ר וַיִּקְרָ֗א אֶת־ שֵׁ֤ם הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנָ֔ה עַ֣ל שֶׁם־ שֶׁ֔מֶר אֲדֹנֵ֖י הָהָ֥ר שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·qen ’eṯ- hā·hār šō·mə·rō·wn mê·’eṯ še·mer bə·ḵik·kə·ra·yim kā·sep̄ way·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- hā·hār way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- šêm hā·‘îr ’ă·šer bā·nāh ‘al šem- še·mer ’ă·ḏō·nê hā·hār šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver and built a city there calling - it - Samaria after the name of Shemer who had owned the hill
verses.literalPt: Comprou de Semer o outeiro de Samaria por dois talentos de prata; edificou no outeiro e chamou a cidade que edificou Samaria, do nome de Semer, senhor do outeiro.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה עָמְרִ֛י הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיָּ֕רַע מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śeh ‘ā·mə·rî hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh way·yā·ra‘ mik·kōl ’ă·šer lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: But Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD and acted more wickedly than all who were before him
verses.literalPt: Fez Onri o mal à vista de Jeová e procedeu mais perversamente do que todos os que foram antes dele.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּכָל־ דֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֔ט וּבְחַטֹּאתָיו אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְהַכְעִ֗יס אֶת־ יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּהַבְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ bə·ḵāl de·reḵ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ū·ḇə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯå̄w ’ă·šer he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl lə·haḵ·‘îs ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl bə·haḇ·lê·hem
verses.literal: For he walked in all the ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat and in his sins which he caused Israel to commit provoking the LORD the God of Israel to anger with their worthless idols
verses.literalPt: Pois ele andou em todos os caminhos de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, e em todos os pecados com que este fizera Israel pecar, para irritar com suas vaidades a Jeová, Deus de Israel.

verses.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֤י עָמְרִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וּגְבוּרָת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹֽא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê ‘ā·mə·rî ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ū·ḡə·ḇū·rā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hă·lō- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Omri along with his accomplishments . . . and the might he exercised are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ora, o restante dos atos que Onri fez e o poder que manifestou não estão, porventura, escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel?

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב עָמְרִי֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אַחְאָ֥ב בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ ‘ā·mə·rî ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·qā·ḇêr bə·šō·mə·rō·wn way·yim·lōḵ ’aḥ·’āḇ bə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Omri rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria and his son Ahab reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Onri adormeceu com seus pais e foi sepultado em Samaria. Em seu lugar, reinou seu filho Acabe.

verses.original: וְאַחְאָ֣ב בֶּן־ עָמְרִ֗י מָלַךְ֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וּשְׁמֹנֶה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְאָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ֠יִּמְלֹךְ אַחְאָ֨ב בֶּן־ עָמְרִ֤י עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁתַּ֖יִם שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḥ·’āḇ ben- ‘ā·mə·rî mā·laḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl biš·naṯ šə·lō·šîm ū·šə·mō·neh šā·nāh lə·’ā·sā me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh way·yim·lōḵ ’aḥ·’āḇ ben- ‘ā·mə·rî ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl bə·šō·mə·rō·wn ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·ta·yim šā·nāh
verses.literal: In the thirty-eighth . . . year of Asa’s reign over Judah Ahab son of Omri became king of Israel - and he reigned - in Samaria twenty-two . . . years
verses.literalPt: No trigésimo oitavo ano de Asa, rei de Judá, começou Acabe, filho de Onri, a reinar sobre Israel; e reinou sobre Israel, em Samaria, vinte e dois anos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ אַחְאָ֧ב בֶּן־ עָמְרִ֛י הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’aḥ·’āḇ ben- ‘ā·mə·rî hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh mik·kōl ’ă·šer lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: However, Ahab son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD more than all who were before him
verses.literalPt: Acabe, filho de Onri, fez o mal à vista de Jeová mais do que todos os que foram antes dele.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ הֲנָקֵ֣ל לֶכְתּ֔וֹ בְּחַטֹּ֖אות יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֑ט וַיִּקַּ֨ח אִשָּׁ֜ה אֶת־ אִיזֶ֗בֶל בַּת־ אֶתְבַּ֙עַל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ צִידֹנִ֔ים וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֣ד אֶת־ הַבַּ֔עַל וַיִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî hă·nā·qêl leḵ·tōw bə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ way·yiq·qaḥ ’iš·šāh ’eṯ- ’î·ze·ḇel baṯ- ’eṯ·ba·‘al me·leḵ ṣî·ḏō·nîm way·yê·leḵ way·ya·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- hab·ba·‘al way·yiš·ta·ḥū lōw
verses.literal: And as if it were not enough for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat he even married . . . Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians and he then proceeded to serve - and worship Baal
verses.literalPt: Como se fora coisa de somenos importância andar ele nos pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, tomou por mulher a Jezabel, filha de Etbaal, rei dos sidônios, e foi, e serviu a Baal, e o adorou.

verses.original: וַיָּ֥קֶם מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַבָּ֑עַל בֵּ֣ית הַבַּ֔עַל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qem miz·bê·aḥ lab·bā·‘al bêṯ hab·ba·‘al ’ă·šer bā·nāh bə·šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: First, Ahab set up an altar for Baal in the temple of Baal that he had built in Samaria
verses.literalPt: Levantou um altar para Baal na casa de Baal, que ele tinha edificado em Samaria.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אַחְאָ֖ב אֶת־ הָאֲשֵׁרָ֑ה וַיּ֨וֹסֶף אַחְאָ֜ב לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת לְהַכְעִיס֙ אֶת־ יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִכֹּ֨ל מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’aḥ·’āḇ ’eṯ- hā·’ă·šê·rāh way·yō·w·sep̄ ’aḥ·’āḇ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lə·haḵ·‘îs ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl mik·kōl mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer hā·yū lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: Then he set up an Asherah pole Thus Ahab did more to provoke the LORD the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel - before him
verses.literalPt: Também fabricou Acabe a Aserá, e fez muito mais para irritar a Jeová, Deus de Israel, do que todos os reis de Israel que foram antes dele.

verses.original: בְּיָמָ֞יו בָּנָ֥ה חִיאֵ֛ל בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלִ֖י אֶת־ יְרִיחֹ֑ה בַּאֲבִירָ֨ם בְּכֹר֜וֹ יִסְּדָ֗הּ וּבִשְׂגִיב צְעִירוֹ֙ הִצִּ֣יב דְּלָתֶ֔יהָ כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַ֖ד יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בִּן־ נֽוּן׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·yā·māw bā·nāh ḥî·’êl bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lî ’eṯ- yə·rî·ḥōh ba·’ă·ḇî·rām bə·ḵō·rōw yis·sə·ḏāh ū·ḇiś·ḡīḇ ṣə·‘î·rōw hiṣ·ṣîḇ də·lā·ṯe·hā kiḏ·ḇar Yah·weh ’ă·šer dib·ber bə·yaḏ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn
verses.literal: In Ahab’s days Hiel the Bethelite rebuilt Jericho At the cost of Abiram his firstborn he laid its foundation and at the cost of Segub his youngest he set up its gates according to the word that the LORD had spoken through Joshua son of Nun
verses.literalPt: Foi em seus dias que Hiel, betelita, edificou a Jericó; quando lançou os seus alicerces, morreu-lhe Abirão, seu primogênito; e, quando colocou as suas portas, morreu-lhe Segube, seu filho mais moço, conforme a palavra que Jeová falou por intermédio de Josué, filho de Num.
